run_testRealVideo: run the testRealVideo script to separate audio from video speakers using pretrained neural networks
build_lipreadingnet: build a lipreading neural network using ModelBuilder with config path, weights, and feature extraction options
build_facial: build a facial attributes network using ModelBuilder with pool type, feature dimension, and weights
get_separated_audio: get separated audio from mixed spectrogram using lipreading, facial, and UNet networks with visual features
audio_normalize: normalize audio samples to a desired RMS level and return the normalization factor and scaled samples
